create_dataset_make_circles: create a noisy circular toy dataset using datasets.make_circles with n_samples and noise parameters
create_dataset_make_moons: create a noisy moon-shaped toy dataset using datasets.make_moons with n_samples and noise parameters
create_dataset_make_blobs: create a blob toy dataset using datasets.make_blobs with n_samples and cluster_std parameters
build_agglomerative_clustering: build hierarchical clustering with AgglomerativeClustering using ward, complete, average, or single linkage
run_standard_scaler: run StandardScaler to normalize dataset features for easier parameter selection
